whatsNew.en-AU: Clearer messages while mdbase upgrades its sync service. If your collection is being moved, TaskNotes now shows mdbase's explanation directly instead of a generic error. When a newer version of TaskNotes is needed, an Update TaskNotes button takes you to the update. While an upgrade is in progress, TaskNotes waits and reconnects automatically, and keeps what you have open on screen.

reviewNotes:
TaskNotes 1.0.9 update

REVIEW ACCESS
No login credentials or sample files are required to review the included demo. On a fresh installation, choose "Try a disposable demo" on the opening screen. This opens an included in-memory collection populated with sample tasks. Demo changes are intentionally discarded when the app restarts. Connecting a persistent mdbase collection is optional and requires the user to authorize access.

CHANGES IN THIS UPDATE
mdbase, the service that stores a user's optional persistent collection, is moving collections to a new sync service. While a collection is being moved, or after it has moved, the service declines requests from older app versions with a short plain-language explanation. Previously TaskNotes hid that explanation behind a generic error and a Retry button. This update shows the explanation as the main text and offers the action that helps: an "Update TaskNotes" button that opens the update page in the browser when a newer version is needed, an automatic wait-and-reconnect while a move is in progress, or the explanation alone if the account needs attention from mdbase support. Unsaved work on screen is kept. These messages appear only when the mdbase service sends them, so they cannot be shown from the demo, and the demo is unchanged. There are no new permissions, no data collection changes and no other visual changes; the existing screenshots remain representative.

FUNCTIONS AND AUDIENCE
TaskNotes is a task manager for people who want portable structured Markdown records. Users can capture, edit, complete, search, assign and reorder tasks; set dates, priorities, recurrence, reminders and time estimates; use lists, boards and calendars; attach images; and turn Scratchpad notes into tasks.

OPTIONAL SERVICES
mdbase provides access to an authorized persistent collection and reminder timers. Firebase Cloud Messaging and Apple Push Notification service deliver content-free reminder notifications after explicit opt-in. The disposable demo does not require an account or external collection.
